# Aditya Birla Centre for Community Initiatives and Rural Development

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **complete** · Search and document budget for this pass reached; no dated (FY-specific) group-level CSR report was located online in the sources read, and ABCICRD does not itself file a CSR-2, so csr_year/csr_spend/footprint/partner-with-FY/stated_geography-with-state/grant/identifier concepts could not be completed at the group level with the required fields.

Aditya Birla Group is a diversified conglomerate; it is not itself a Section-135 CSR filer. Its group-wide CSR is coordinated by the Aditya Birla Centre for Community Initiatives and Rural Development (ABCICRD), chaired by Mrs. Rajashree Birla and headed operationally by Dr. Pragnya Ram, which sets strategic direction across listed operating companies (Grasim, Hindalco, UltraTech, Aditya Birla Capital, Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail, Vodafone Idea), each of which implements CSR and files its own statutory CSR-2 separately. The Centre states five thematic pillars (education, healthcare, sustainable livelihood, infrastructure development, social reforms), reports reaching '7,000+ villages' and 'nine million people', running 56 schools (46,500+ students) and midday meals for 70,000+ children, and states cumulative global CSR investment 'exceeds Rs. 500 crores' (undated, not tied to one fiscal year). No group-level, FY-specific CSR-2 style figures (prescribed CSR, spend, unspent) exist because the Group itself does not file one. Company-specific figures seen on the same pages (e.g. Grasim/Hindalco/UltraTech/ABFRL infrastructure and skilling beneficiary counts, Hindalco's Kosala Livelihood and Social Foundation, Aditya Birla Rural Technology Park at Muirpur and Aditya Birla Skills Foundation at Dhanupali which are actually Hindalco-supported) were deliberately NOT attributed to 'Aditya Birla Group' as findings here, since they belong to the named subsidiary, not to the Centre/Group entity. Generic mentions of 'government bodies, district authorities, village panchayats' as development partners lacked a stated fiscal year, so no partner record could be written (fiscal_year is required for that concept); likewise no state/district-level priority geography was stated at the Group/Centre level (only a national village/people aggregate), so no stated_geography or footprint record could be written.

Website: https://www.adityabirla.com

## What it set out to find

- identity/legal name/website of the group-level CSR umbrella body (ABCICRD)
- relationship notes: conglomerate structure, not a single Section-135 filer
- stated priority geography (villages/districts) at group level, kept separate from subsidiary footprints
- named partners at group level
- programs/themes coordinated by the Centre
- group-wide metrics (villages/people reached, schools, students, midday meals, CSR investment)
- contacts (office bearers) of the Centre
- documents describing group CSR strategy
